item.title: Rumi Ramen? ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Cook Up Instant Noodle Collab That You Can Buy Online Now
item.description:
Here's a short, engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Upbeat music plays in the background]
Host: "Hey there, K-Pop fans! Are you ready for some exciting news? The global phenomenon, KPop Demon Hunters, has just expanded its merchandise lineup to include something delicious - ramen noodles!
That's right, the Netflix animated film has collaborated with South Korean instant noodle company, Nongshim, to bring you a unique range of ramen flavors inspired by the HUNTR/X members. From Rumi's spicy and smoky flavor to Zoey's hamburger-inspired broth and Mira's signature spicy queen flavor, there's something for everyone.
[Short sound effects: A ramen packet being opened, a spoon clinking against a bowl]
Host: "Each character has their own signature flavor and colored cup, reflecting their identity. And the best part? These ramen noodles are now available in the US, so you can get your hands on them at Amazon or Walmart.
[Short sound effects: A microwave beeping, a satisfied "mmm" sound]
Host: "The noodles are designed to hold rich broths, with added texture and flavor from flake packets. And with microwave-ready preparation, you can enjoy your KPop Demon Hunters ramen in just minutes.
[Upbeat music continues to play]
Host: "So, which flavor will you try first? Let us know in the comments! And don't forget to check out the links in our show notes to get your hands on these limited-edition ramen noodles. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next episode!"
[Music and sound effects fade out]
